newsitem.title: USA: Petitions readied in movement to abolish Miami.
newsitem.headline: Petitions readied in movement to abolish Miami.

text.p: A citizens' group said it would formally submit petitions Tuesday calling for a referendum to dissolve the City of Miami and absorb it into the Dade County government.

The petitions bearing 20,247 voter signatures were to be turned over to Dade County Elections Supervisor David Leahy for signature verification. If a random check indicates the signatures are valid, the Miami City Commission will have 120 days to draft an abolish-Miami ballot question, and another 120 days to hold an election.

The signatures were collected by a group called Citizens for Lower Taxes, which said fees and taxes paid by the average Miami homeowner would be reduced by $612 a year if the city is absorbed into the Metro-Dade government.
Mayor Joe Carollo disputed that, putting the savings at only $230 a year.
The 100-year-old city is struggling to close a $68 million deficit in its $275 million budget for the year that began Oct 1, and has been placed under supervision of a state oversight board.
